name: safemigrate-mcp
title: SafeMigrate MCP Guard
description: Deterministic AST migration analyzer and zero-downtime SQL rewriter for PostgreSQL and MySQL. Prevents ACCESS EXCLUSIVE locks and full table rewrites during autonomous coding agent execution.

tools.name: analyze_migration
tools.description: Analyzes raw SQL DDL for blocking locks (ACCESS EXCLUSIVE, SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE), table rewrites, and concurrency risks.

tools.name: rewrite_zero_downtime
tools.description: Rewrites unsafe migrations into concurrent, zero-downtime SQL operations.

tools.name: check_rollback_safety
tools.description: Cross-analyzes forward (UP) and rollback (DOWN) migration scripts for irreversible data loss.
